note: Single-large-prime residual sweep inside ic.pipeline against the pair-table recipe and rho.negation, same binary, sessions, targets and rounds. A structural result, not a leaderboard row: the sweep is a birthday collision search with memory growing like sqrt(r B). The schema's `ic` band slot carries the B = 2 arm; the matched rho reference is the session's own rho.negation arm.

rho_reference.band_source: ../../research/ic_residual_sweep_20261028/band/sweep-32.json (ic.pipeline residual-sweep:m=2 with a base of 2 abscissae, 32-bit prime-order curve, 3 sessions)
rho_reference.binary_or_process: ecbench release build of this branch; every arm of a session runs in that session's binary
rho_reference.protocol: each spec's rho.negation reference arm (role reference), run in every session on the same curve, targets and rounds as the candidate arms; prime-order curves (A = 2), so negation is the strongest symmetry available
